profile.reading:
This record needs a location correction before anything else can be said about it. The OpenStreetMap way behind it, named Centrum Przetwarzania Danych T-Mobile Polska with the operator T-Mobile Polska and the reference (3B), sits at coordinates that fall in Piaseczno, in powiat piaseczynski in Mazovia, roughly 20 kilometres south of central Warsaw and outside the city boundary. It stands in the industrial and commercial belt around Fabryczna and Kolejowa streets on the Loziska and Stara Iwiczna side of the town, next to the Diamond Business Park Piaseczno estate, which OpenStreetMap also carries under the alternative name Logicor Piaseczno, and near a Raben Polska logistics site. The reference (3B) is consistent with a hall or building number inside a multi building estate of that kind.

An earlier version of this page described T-Mobile Polska's data centre on ulica Szlachecka, and that description has been removed from this record because it belongs to a different building. The Szlachecka facility is well documented. T-Mobile Polska signed a contract with the Austrian construction group STRABAG on 8 July 2020 for a turnkey data centre there, scheduled for completion in September 2021, built as a reinforced concrete monolithic structure with three above ground storeys of office and technical space, about 4,400 square metres of usable floor area and about 20,700 cubic metres of volume, designed to ANSI/TIA-942 Rated-3 so that its architectural, mechanical, cooling, ventilation, power and telecommunications systems are all fully redundant. Ulica Szlachecka lies roughly seven kilometres north of the object recorded here, on the south western edge of Warsaw, so the two cannot be the same structure.

What remains firmly established for this row is the operator and its business. T-Mobile Polska is the Polish operating company of the Deutsche Telekom group and sells colocation, dedicated servers, private cloud, virtual data centre, hybrid cloud, disaster recovery as a service and managed backup from a national data centre estate that the company has described as running to roughly fifteen sites across Poland, offering geographically redundant recovery between them. A carrier of that size operating a technical building in a Piaseczno business park is entirely plausible.

What is not established is anything specific about this building. The OpenStreetMap object was created in a single edit in October 2025 by one contributor, and no operator publication, construction record or planning document found here confirms a T-Mobile data centre at that address, or gives an IT load, a utility power service rating, standby generator capacity or a technical floor area for it. This registry records the object, the operator attribution and the location correction, and leaves the capacity fields empty rather than importing figures that belong to another site.
profile.research_note: Location error found and corrected 2026-09-05. The prior page attributed T-Mobile Polska's ul. Szlachecka data centre in Warsaw to this row. Nominatim reverse geocode on the stored coordinates (52.0787411, 21.006019) returns Piaseczno, gmina Piaseczno, powiat piaseczynski, 05-500, and an OSM map bbox around the point returns the Diamond Business Park Piaseczno / Logicor Piaseczno commercial estate and Raben Polska logistics land, not ul. Szlachecka. A Nominatim street search bounded to the Warsaw area places ulica Szlachecka at about 52.1340, 20.9636 in Dawidy Bankowe on the south western city edge, roughly 7 km north of this object. Szlachecka construction facts re-verified this session directly from STRABAG's own project page (contract 2020-07-08, completion September 2021, 4,400 sqm usable, 20,700 cubic metres, ANSI/TIA-942 Rated-3) and are now clearly attributed to that other building. OSM provenance: way/1442986078 has one version, created 2025-10-18 by tymons565 with building=yes, name, operator, ref=(3B) and telecom=data_center. No independent confirmation of a T-Mobile data centre at the Piaseczno coordinates was found, so no capacity, power or area figure is recorded. Previously-set building_sqft and technical_space_sqft keys on this row derive from the Szlachecka building and should be reviewed by a later pass.
